source: bundle.js -> readable/bundle.pretty.js (23979 lines). The bundle is javascript-obfuscator protected (string array + decoder `b` + rotator IIFE, aliases of `cX`); tools/deobfuscate.mjs runs the array in a VM and inlines all 20736 encoded-string calls into readable/bundle.deob.pretty.js. All app slices below are cut from the deobfuscated view so every string reads literally.
note: Line numbers index readable/bundle.deob.pretty.js. The first 3746 lines are the obfuscator runtime + game data tables (changelog, weapons, palettes, maps); the string-array function `a` (L15643) is data, not logic, and is indexed by the data-tables slice range it sits in. src/ slices carry semantic renames (209 identifiers); runtime index.html is untouched. Spec renameMap documents the mapping.

sections.title: Obfuscator runtime & bootstrapping
sections.desc: String array, decoder `b`, rotator IIFE, and the first defines (Object.defineProperty helpers). Kept because the mirror's bundle still depends on it at load.

sections.title: Changelog data
sections.desc: Version history (`x`): releases, dates, FEATURE/FIX entries — version 0.3.0, 2026-09-12.

sections.title: Advisor/comms lines & key labels
sections.desc: Loading-screen quips (`il`), key-name mapping, input label helpers.

sections.title: Audio engine
sections.desc: AudioContext setup, ambience/music/sfx playback, oscillator-based effects, volume settings.

sections.title: Value noise (terrain generation)
sections.desc: `hs` class: seeded permutation table + smooth 2-D value noise + fBm octaves — drives map terrain generation.

sections.title: Sprite palettes & colour tables
sections.desc: Per-faction/per-unit colour definitions (helmet, face, kit, boots…), terrain and canvas palettes.

sections.title: Asset loading & boot sequence
sections.desc: `Ss` boot stages (boot/sprites/missions/ready), font/image loading, sprite atlas decode (`m1`).

sections.title: DOM UI framework
sections.desc: Widget builder (`w`), modals, confirm dialogs, changelog renderer, briefing/mission-select screens, HUD panels, leaderboard UI.

sections.title: Multiplayer networking
sections.desc: `ii` WebSocket client class: dial/retry, greeting, lobby join codes, message queue; `wy` ws URL builder. Live-only — the offline mirror stubs the /ws endpoint.

sections.title: Lobby & leaderboard screens
sections.desc: Public/private room listing, join codes, multiplayer stats (`mp-stats`), leaderboard feed rendering.

sections.title: Sprite atlas & canvas renderer
sections.desc: Atlas-backed canvas layers: terrain canvas, decal layer (`yi`), fog mask, pixel-smoothed blitting — the 2-D rendering core.

sections.title: String-array data (maps & mission text)
sections.desc: The obfuscator string array `a()` lives here in the deob view: ASCII mission maps (terrain glyphs #,~,T,%,E,P…), soldier surnames (OAKES, BENNET, KANE…), briefing lines, UI labels. Pure data.

sections.title: Soldier model & spawn factory
sections.desc: Soldier state template (screamTimer, stagger, sliding…), `WW` soldier spawn factory, faction helpers (`eW`, `Mr`), squad filtering.

sections.title: Simulation: combat, AI, orders
sections.desc: Firing, grenades, call-ins (airstrike), enemy AI think/flank/patrol, objectives (hold position, assassinate), effects (`Effects`), terrain interaction (deep water, quicksand, ice).

sections.title: HUD state & main loop
sections.desc: Loadout HUD binding, mission timer/results, `T5` summary builder, end-of-mission screens and the final bootstrap lines.
